requirement_table.text: ID register at 0x000 reads 0x20940001.
BUILD register at 0x004 reads the USR_ACCESSE2 word of the bitstream.
SCRATCH at 0x008 reads back the value written.
Reads of unmapped addresses return 0.
Writes to unmapped addresses change no register state.
h_rdata shows the addressed register within 2 clk cycles of h_re.
Each output equals saturate16((sum h[k]*x[n-k] + 0x4000) >>> 15) bit for bit against the Python model.
The impulse input produces outputs identical to the Python model.
The step input produces outputs identical to the Python model.
10,000 random samples sent in 10 chunks of 1,000 without CLEAR match the model bit for bit.
Samples before the first one are treated as 0.
Filter history is kept across RUN commands and zeroed only by CLEAR.
The datapath accepts one sample per clk_dsp cycle.
The datapath meets timing at 250 MHz clk_dsp with WNS of 0 ns or more.
The multipliers are mapped to DSP48E2 slices and the report lists the DSP count.
The design uses 16 multipliers by exploiting coefficient symmetry.
The build report shows the clk_dsp frequency that timing met.
The input FIFO holds 1024 samples.
IN_PUSH is ignored when the input FIFO is full.
The output FIFO holds 1024 samples.
OUT_POP returns bit 31 = 1 and the oldest output in bits 15:0 and removes it.
OUT_POP on an empty output FIFO returns 0.
RUN processes all samples in the input FIFO in order into the output FIFO.
STATUS bit 0 is 1 from RUN until the last result is in the output FIFO.
STATUS bits 15:4 report the input FIFO count from 0 to 1024.
STATUS bits 31:20 report the output FIFO count from 0 to 1024.
CTRL bit 0 CLEAR empties both FIFOs.
CTRL bit 0 CLEAR zeroes the filter history.
CTRL bit 0 CLEAR zeroes SAT_COUNT and SAMPLES_DONE.
CTRL bit 0 reads 0 one clk cycle after it is written.
SAT_COUNT counts the outputs that saturated since CLEAR.
SAMPLES_DONE counts the samples processed since CLEAR.
The datapath clock is generated from the 25 MHz board clock on pin C3.
sfp_tx_disable is driven to 1 at all times.
The design uses no GT transceiver channel.
jtag_bus.sv is instantiated unchanged.
SCRATCH resets to 0.
h_rdata holds its value until the next h_re.
CTRL bit 1 reads 0 one clk cycle after it is written.
